verdict.rationale: The Cloudflare MoQ docs in the pack cover relay creation, isolated scopes, tokens, and draft versions. None of them explain how the media layer scales across nodes or regions, whether through managed autoscaling or clustering. The community remark about South Korea on a 'global' CDN map concerns a demo and is not vendor documentation of a scaling architecture.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the vendor documents how the media layer scales across nodes or regions, whether managed autoscaling or self-hosted clustering
